subtasks.notes:
Implemented rapid input protection for TV navigation to prevent focus skipping or breaking on rapid button presses:

1. **useTVEventHandler.ts enhancements**:
   - Added throttleNavigationMs option for throttling navigation events
   - Added debounceMs option for debouncing all events
   - Created useRapidInputProtectedTVEventHandler hook with:
     - Per-direction throttling (minNavigationIntervalMs default: 50ms)
     - Event queue with max capacity (maxQueuedEvents default: 3)
     - Frame-aligned processing with requestAnimationFrame
   - Added useThrottledCallback utility for general throttling
   - Added useFocusChangeProtection for debounced focus tracking

2. **useSpatialNavigation.ts enhancements**:
   - Added enableRapidInputProtection option (default: true)
   - Added focusSaveDebounceMs option (default: 16ms = 1 frame)
   - Debounced saveFocus calls to prevent rapid state updates
   - Added throttling to focusElement (MIN_FOCUS_ELEMENT_INTERVAL_MS: 50ms)
   - Added isPendingFocusChange state for tracking pending changes

3. **Focusable.tv.tsx enhancements**:
   - Added RapidInputConfig with:
     - enabled (default: true)
     - minFocusIntervalMs (default: 50ms)
     - cancelAnimationsOnRapidInput (default: true)
   - Cancel running reanimated animations on rapid focus/blur
   - Track focus change timing to coordinate with throttling

Committed as 3f967508.

subtasks.title: Handle long-press during animation
subtasks.description: Queue long-press action if started during focus animation
acceptance_criteria: Action is queued and executed after animation
subtasks.notes:
Implemented animation-aware queuing for long-press actions during focus animations:

1. **useLongPress.ts enhancements**:
   - Added AnimationAwareConfig interface with isAnimating() callback, maxQueueWaitMs (default 500ms), and lifecycle callbacks
   - When isAnimating() returns true during long-press trigger, action is queued instead of executed immediately
   - notifyAnimationComplete() executes queued action after animation finishes
   - cancelQueuedAction() cancels pending queued action
   - isActionQueued state tracks queue status
   - Duplicate prevention via actionExecutedRef ensures actions only execute once
   - Timeout fallback (maxQueueWaitMs) ensures action executes even if animation completion is not notified

2. **Focusable.tv.tsx integration**:
   - Added animationAwareLongPress prop for configuring queuing behavior
   - isAnimatingRef tracks when focus animation is in progress

subtasks.title: Create useSpatialNavigation tests
subtasks.description: Unit tests for focus memory storage and retrieval
subtasks.notes:
Created comprehensive unit tests for useSpatialNavigation hook with 70 passing tests covering:

1. **Focus Memory Storage and Retrieval**:
   - saveFocus() stores focus IDs correctly
   - getSavedFocus() retrieves last focused item correctly
   - clearSavedFocus() clears saved focus
   - Focus memory persists per screen

2. **Focus Restoration**:
   - restoreFocus() restores focus to saved element using setNativeProps
   - Falls back to focus() method if setNativeProps not available
   - Uses defaultFocusId when no saved focus exists
   - Returns false for missing refs (handled gracefully)

3. **Ref Management**:
   - registerRef() and unregisterRef() work correctly
   - getRef() retrieves registered refs
   - Handles empty focusId and null refs gracefully
   - Cleans up all refs on unmount

4. **Node Handle Management**:
   - getNodeHandle() returns node handles for registered refs
   - Returns null for missing refs (handled gracefully)
   - Caches node handles for performance
   - refreshNodeHandles() updates all handles

5. **Next Focus Configuration**:
   - setNextFocus() and getNextFocusProps() work correctly
   - Handles missing refs in next focus configuration
   - Merges configurations correctly

6. **Programmatic Focus Control**:
   - focusElement() focuses elements by ID
   - Throttles rapid focus element calls for stability
   - Returns false for non-existent elements

7. **Rapid Input Protection**:
   - Debounces focus saves to prevent rapid state updates
   - isPendingFocusChange state tracks pending changes
   - Saves last focus ID when multiple rapid saves occur

8. **Utility Hooks**:
   - useFocusableRef creates and registers refs
   - useFocusHandlers provides onFocus/onBlur handlers
   - useGridNavigation sets up grid layouts
   - useEmptyListFocusFallback handles empty content
   - useFocusableFallbackRefs manages fallback refs
   - useLoadingStateFocus handles loading states

9. **Edge Cases**:
   - Handles errors in setNativeProps gracefully
   - Supports very long focus IDs
   - Handles special characters in focus IDs
   - Supports re-registering after unregistering
   - Handles concurrent hooks on different screens

All acceptance criteria met:
✅ Focus IDs stored correctly
✅ Last focused item retrieved correctly
✅ Missing refs handled gracefully
